# CONTRIBUTING.md Template — Companion Resources

Copy-paste files for adding a contribution workflow to any repository.
Companion to the [CONTRIBUTING.md Template doc](https://stackpractices.com/docs/contributing-guide/)
on StackPractices.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | Full contributing guide template (English). Drop it at your repo root and replace the `[placeholders]`. |
| `CONTRIBUTING.es.md` | Same template in Spanish. |
| `SECURITY.md` | Private vulnerability-reporting policy template — the document your contributing guide should link to. |

## How to use

1. Copy `CONTRIBUTING.md` (or `CONTRIBUTING.es.md`) to your repository root.
2. Replace every `[placeholder]` — org/repo names, install/test/lint commands,
   coverage target, contact channels, and response times.
3. Copy `SECURITY.md` as well and keep it next to the guide; the template
   links to it from the "Security Vulnerabilities" section.
4. If the project needs a DCO or CLA, add `DCO.md`/`CLA.md` and link it from
   the commit-message section.
